text:
tara: hey team — day 1 and trying a slightly different setup: using Nix-based devcontainer + zsh. onboarding script assumes asdf/bash. my issues: asdf shims not on PATH inside the Nix container, poetry can't find the right python, and i need to fetch our private PyPI token from 1password into CI-compatible env without writing secrets to disk. also trying to forward ssh agent through gpg-agent socket; container complains socket not found. any quick patterns?

viv: welcome! :wave: for Nix devcontainers we prefer making asdf a user-level package in the container rather than relying on host shims. add `environment.systemPackages = with pkgs; [ asdf ]` to your devshell/nix config or use `nix develop` with `asdf` available. then `eval "$(asdf init -)"` in your zshrc.

sam: poetry + asdf: ensure the asdf python is first in PATH so `poetry env use $(which python)` picks the right interpreter. run `asdf global python 3.11.4` inside container and then `poetry env use 3.11.4` in the project dir. If poetry created a venv with wrong py, `poetry env remove` then recreate.

tara: good call — asdf in Nix fixed. PyPI token question: i need it available to GitHub Actions runner in a safe way; onboarding says use op but most examples write a file. any preferred secure flow?

viv: avoid writing long-lived token files. For CI, the flow is: `op get item pypi-token --fields label=token --cache` on a runner with ephemeral creds (we use GitHub OIDC + short-lived OP session via self-hosted runner). As a quick workaround locally you can `op item get pypi-token --fields token --raw > /tmp/pypi && pip config set global.index-url https://__token__:<$(cat /tmp/pypi)>@pypi.redwood.internal/simple` then `shred -u /tmp/pypi`. Docs in intranet.devops have the OIDC + OP setup.

sam: ssh/gpg-agent forwarding inside Nix container: mount the gpg-agent socket into the container and set `GNUPGHOME` to match. Example: run container with `-v $GNUPGHOME:/home/vscode/.gnupg:ro -v /run/user/1000/gnupg/S.gpg-agent:/run/gnupg/S.gpg-agent -e GPG_AGENT_INFO=/run/gnupg/S.gpg-agent`. But better is to forward agent socket via ssh-agent instead for SSH key forwarding; mount `$SSH_AUTH_SOCK` and set `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` env inside container.

security-bot: Reminder: do not mount full GNUPGHOME with private key files in writable mode. Use socket forwarding and read-only mounts for necessary public data. For CI secrets use short-lived tokens or Vault-backed secrets.

tara: awesome — one small nixy quirk: direnv keeps trying to run `asdf` on shell entry before Nix has finished provisioning, causing race. any debounce trick?

viv: put a guard in your `.envrc`: `if [ -x "$HOME/.asdf/bin/asdf" ]; then eval "$(asdf init -)"; fi` and use `layout` function in nix to ensure asdf present before direnv tries to eval. Also we added a small sleep in bootstrap to handle first-run provisioning.

tara: thanks all — got asdf working in Nix, poetry pointing to the right python, and socket-forwarding for SSH. i'll open a small PR to the onboarding repo to add the Nix devcontainer notes. :tada:
